scheme_name: Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme)
description: Financial assistance scheme by the Government of Tamil Nadu to encourage female students from government schools to pursue higher education.
benefits: ₹1,000 per month paid directly into the bank account until the completion of Undergraduate Degree, Diploma, ITI, or professional course.

eligibility_rules.source: G.O. (Ms) No. 18, Social Welfare & Women Empowerment Dept, TN

eligibility_rules.description: Must be currently enrolled in higher education (UG Degree, Diploma, or ITI)
eligibility_rules.source: G.O. (Ms) No. 18, Social Welfare & Women Empowerment Dept, TN

eligibility_rules.description: Must have studied from Class 6 to Class 12 in Tamil Nadu Government Schools
Applicant must be a resident of Tamil Nadu

required_documents: School Transfer Certificate (Class 6 to 12 proof in TN Govt School)
application_method: Online application via Pen Kalvi Portal (penkalvi.tn.gov.in) through the applicant's higher education institution.
source_document: Tamil Nadu Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department Notification 2022
